<!---## Bio-->
### *Welcome!*

I'm a PhD student in Economics at [UC Berkeley](https://www.econ.berkeley.edu/). I specialize in:

* Industrial Organization

* Applied Economic Theory

I'm broadly interested in problems related to:

* Digital platforms

* Regulation under information asymmetry and contractual frictions

* Inequality-aware market design

* Economics of AI

Prior to Berkeley, I was a research fellow at Stanford Law School (2022-2024), where I worked on projects in law and economics and led the development of the [Lanterman Fair Hearing Smart Search Tool](https://siddlapp-fair-hearing-search-tool.law.stanford.edu/).

You can find my research [here](https://haosenhe.github.io/research.html). 

Contact: haosen_he [at] berkeley.edu.

---

### *What's New:*

*July 2026*: I presented at [SAET 2026](https://saet.uiowa.edu/2026-conference/) in Rio de Janeiro on July 17, 2026.

*May 2026*: Check out my new [working paper](https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6806518) on how to optimally regulate social media platforms.
